events.place: Konary, Gmina Grodziec, Słupca Powiat, Kalisz Governorate, Congress Poland
events.note:
In her marriage certificate in C1402, her place of birth is only listed as "Konary" (and there are multiple places named Konary in Poland). The one near Grodziec was chosen, as it appears that the Zelmers and other settlers in the Pożdżenice area came from the same area.

Finding her birth certificate in Grodziec Evangelical parish records would confirm is this assumption is correct.
